title_original: Hollywood Marketing Leaders Gather for a Candid Conversation About the Future of Entertainment

blocks.text: Top Hollywood film and TV leaders gathered Oct. 22 for an intimate dinner and candid conversation about the future of entertainment marketing at a gathering moderated in partnership with Amazon Ads and Variety .

Executives who convened at BOA Steakhouse in West Hollywood compared notes and talked shop about the buzzy subjects that are transforming the business and execution of marketing campaigns, from tune-in to image burnishing to whisper campaigns to event promotion.
